products.title: ClimaCuddle® Zipped Baby Romper - Merino Wool & Rayon From Bamboo - Misty Blue - 9-12M
products.description: Made from our climate-smart ClimaCuddle® fabric, this infant long sleeve romper blends breathable bamboo with temperature-regulating Merino wool to keep your baby cozy in every season. Soft on sensitive skin and designed with a stretchy fit that won’t ride up during tummy time, it keeps your little one comfy all day. ClimaCuddle® climate-smart fabric : 50.8% rayon from bamboo | 49.2% Merino wool Curved double zipper Fold-over cuffs for warmth and scratch protection Flatlock seams for a smooth feel against the skin Breathable underarm gusset Temperature-sensing sticker to guide comfort decisions A personalized embroidered romper adds a unique touch to your baby's moments.

products.title: Vibora Black Mamba Evo Pro Black 2026 - by Vibor
products.description:
VIBORA BLACK MAMBA EVO PRO BLACK 2026 - A racket that will give you total security in every stroke. With a round-hybrid format, it is a safe racket for right-wing players who want to take one more step towards the net. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The VIBORA BLACK MAMBA EVO PRO BLACK 2026 is one of the best alternatives from the Spanish brand. This new feature includes the new JACQUARD carbon, which greatly increases durability.

PLAYER TYPE

This model is recommended for players with a high level of play, especially advanced players, since we are dealing with a high-end model.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The VIBORA BLACK MAMBA EVO PRO BLACK 2026 is one of the best Vibora padel rackets of the 2026 season.

Its characteristics are:

- Round-hybrid format. It is an oversized format, complete and balanced and with a greatly expanded sweet spot.

- JACQUARD carbon fiber, a new material, an improved and reinforced carbon for players who hit the ball hard.

- Professional Eva Rubber, Vibora's best rubber, developed in the high-end 2026 collection. This rubber is of medium density and with high response and ball output.

- New mold with an aerodynamic structure in the bridge, where air is allowed to pass and thus achieve better handling.

products.title: Siux Astra Hybrid 2026 - Siux
products.description:
SIUX ASTRA HYBRID 2026 - Meet the new hybrid racket of the ASTRA series. A hybrid-teardrop format racket for players who want excellent balance. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The SIUX ASTRA HYBRID 2026 is a racket that shines for its balance. Its name "Hybrid" already gives us a clue as to what type of racket it is. It is a balanced model that suits everyone and is focused on an amateur audience that plays regularly.

PLAYER TYPE

It is a racket designed, above all, for intermediate level players who are in a phase of evolution and want to improve their game without complicating themselves with a racket that is too demanding.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The SIUX ASTRA HYBRID 2026 is a very complete padel racket, and made of fiberglass both in frame and in planes. It is a 3K, interwoven fiberglass.

At its core, we have a soft, soft EVA rubber that does not transmit vibrations and is therefore a good option for players who suffer from elbow pain.

products.title: Wilson Blade V4 2026 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON BLADE V4 2026 - The new Blade arrives renewed, with a slight design change and with improved technologies to achieve a more balanced and durable racket. Without a doubt, one of the Wilson rackets with the best quality-price ratio. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON BLADE V4 2026 arrives completely renewed to continue being one of the brand's most balanced padel rackets. Its teardrop format helps us achieve that balance so desired by players.

It is a racket that transmits a lot of confidence both from the back of the court and in the net game.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for players looking for an excellent compromise between control, power and comfort, it offers a very versatile behavior that adapts to any match situation.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The materials in the WILSON BLADE V4 2026 are quality. We find a combination of carbon fiber and fiberglass. With this duo, a balanced, flexible feel and good durability are achieved.

Its rubber is firm Foam, a hard and stable rubber that increases the power in our blows, but also leaving us with the characteristic softness of foam rubber.

Its technologies are: a rough surface Spin Effect Texture, which facilitates the generation of effects. Its C2 Tubular Construction structure, made entirely of carbon. In addition, the Anti-Fragile Edge protector reinforces the frame against bumps and scratches, while the Duo Grid Hole system optimizes the performance of the hitting surface.

products.title: Asics Solution Swift Ff 2 Padel White Dark Cobalt - Asics
products.description:
ASICS SOLUTION SWIFT FF 2 PADEL WHITE DARK COBALT - The Asics Solution Swift FF 2 Padel are a clear commitment to agility, stability and innovation, with a clean and sporty design. INTRODUCTION OF THE SNEAKERS

The ASICS SOLUTION SWIFT FF 2 PADEL WHITE DARK COBALT are one of the brand's most comfortable shoes for the 2025 season.

PLAYER TYPE

Intermediate to advanced level players looking for speed, grip and cushioning in a shoe that meets every demand of the game.

MOST IMPORTANT CONSTRUCTION DATA

This model incorporates a mixed sole (clay + omni), which makes it perfect for artificial grass padel courts, even with sand. It offers the right balance between grip and sliding.

Its technologies are:

FlyteFoam: Lightweight, responsive cushioning that reduces impact without sacrificing speed. Ideal for maintaining pace in long matches without leg fatigue.

Twistruss: Technology in the middle zone that improves stability and torsion, allowing faster and safer turns. Perfect for covering the net and returning to the bottom in thousandths.

AHAR+: Ultra-resistant rubber compound in key areas of the sole. Translated: more durability, even with demanding workouts and intensive use.

Seamless technical mesh: Light, breathable and flexible upper that adapts to the foot like a glove. Promotes ventilation and avoids pressure points.

products.title: Paletero Softee Carburo - Softee
products.description:
SOFTEE CARBURE PADEL BAG - Modern Softee padel bag for the 2024 season. Space for everything, including a compartment only for padel shoes. The SOFTEE CARBURO PADEL BAG is a padel racket bag with Premium finishes, with large compartments for padel rackets, shoes, and all the items necessary to enjoy padel.

We find this specific model available in various colors in our padel store. Choose yours and the one that looks best with your sports outfits.

Its main compartment has a wide and comfortable tongue-shaped opening, which allows objects to be introduced more comfortably.

It also has two padded handles to transport it very comfortably and is also made of synthetic leather, which gives it a much more Premium and elegant touch in all its colors.

products.title: Pala Pickleball Adidas Adipower Attack 3 - Palas De Pickleball
products.description:
ADIDAS ADIPOWER ATTACK 3 PICKLEBALL RACKET - It is designed for advanced players who seek maximum power in each shot.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The ADIDAS ADIPOWER ATTACK 3 PICKLEBALL RACKET is a model designed for an offensive game, where speed and punch make the difference.

PLAYER TYPE

It is aimed at advanced level players who base their game on attacking strokes.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Its attack format places the sweet spot at the top of the racket. In addition, its thickness of 14mm. It offers a very interesting balance between power, feel and control.

Made with high quality carbon: 24K aluminized carbon that offers great durability and power.

Inside, it incorporates an HD Polypropylene Honeycomb core, which is a high-density structure that provides a firmer feel and extra power in intense hits.

In the ADIDAS ADIPOWER ATTACK 3 PICKLEBALL RACKET we highlight several more features:

- Spin Blade Max: is a rough surface that maximizes the effects of blows.

- Structural Reinformcement: is a carbon perimeter reinforcement that improves durability.

- Extra Power Grip: which consists of a longer handle (5") that increases inertia.

- Comfort Grip: padded EVA rubber handle and perforated surface for greater comfort and grip.

- Upgraded Edge Guard: it is a perimeter protector that protects the racket against friction.

products.title: Pack Of 3 Dunlop Fort Padel Boots - Padel Balls
products.description: We bring the PACK OF 3 DUNLOP FORT PADEL BOTTLES, this ball guarantees good durability since it is high-end. It is a ball that favors play in all seasons of the year.  With this ball you will be able to achieve a more aggressive and therefore effective game.
